seo.title: Invenio Homes — A private collection of houses
seo.description: A carefully selected, fully licensed collection of villas in Ibiza, Formentera, Mykonos and Bali — with a platform for agents and owners, and a team on the ground.

hero.title: A private collection of houses in the *places we love*.
hero.lede: Fully licensed villas, looked after by people who live there — and a platform that makes the whole season feel lighter.
hero.imageAlt: A whitewashed Invenio villa and pool at dusk in Ibiza
hero.caption: Can Nemo, Ibiza — 38°54′N 1°25′E

intro.title: We are a small, multilingual team with a long memory for good houses — and a firm focus on the relationships that keep them.
intro.body: Invenio helps the best agents and villa owners grow their businesses without the noise. We visit every property, check every licence, and put a named person on the other end of the line. The rest is technology doing its quiet work.

images.alt: A shaded lounge opening onto a pool at an Invenio villa
Long outdoor dining table under parasols

marquee.lineTwo: Licensed houses — On-island people — One standard —

collection.title: A carefully selected, fully licensed portfolio.
collection.body: Every house is visited, every licence verified, every rate checked. What you see is what your clients arrive to.

platform.title: Everything the season asks for, on one screen.
platform.body: Realtime availability, accurate rates and a curated portfolio — with a dedicated partner on the other end. Search, hold and share a branded selection in minutes.

destinations.title: Four islands. One standard.

owners.body: Maximum exposure in a competitive market, at your fingertips and under your control — fully supported by consummate professionals. From licensing and photography to the last departure of the season, one team carries it.
